## GATE0 CHECKPOINT · STOP C for #1781 priority — sole Track P #1782

This private worktree is still clean at adopted main `32b63e7bea3be5fd6fafb9f11f8ea0a7fd2376cc`, Draft17.38. The separate #1781 comparison stays `d121c79a0f3cb94da1d2d15aaf789cc16a6e94f0`. Compiler production writes are zero. The prepared local source-change script was not applied. [ACTUAL START](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7154580126) · [Frozen FIRST](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7154617402)

- The chosen ordinary caller passes a fresh read of active's just-updated field, after its first write loan closes, as the same scoped writer's value actual on the independent standby. The three mirror sources passed CHECK and first refused at C17 status 4 `V1-BACKEND-UNSUPPORTED` on both pins. All 11 frozen predictions matched on both pins. The two single-origin controls reached native. #1781 also emitted the independent-literal standby control. The three available controls passed 24 strict native runs total. The escaping reference refused at CHECK with `P8-EXIT-DEPENDENCY`. Refused outputs preserved existing bytes and file identity, absence and no staging residue.
- The well-factored C comparison used one typed exchange object per configuration. All five callers passed GCC/Clang O0/O2 and ASan/LSan/UBSan, for 20 strict and 5 sanitized runs. The actual active read produced standby mode 35 at low load and 93 at high load. Distinct original addresses, separate displaced values 22 and 81, and sibling tags 119 and 147 were preserved.
- Both immutable Gate0 pins carry two original Change replays and true per-original frames. The first Change's post fact and retained value match the middle read. Its individual dependency-free Unknown Copy is the second actual, and the second replay consumes the ordinary formal in its Change. Both scopes and all observed original places end. Gate0 did not select the quantity plan or issue the whole-entry seal for these three sources. [FIRST source and oracle](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1782#issuecomment-7154617402)

The predecessor #1781 natural FULL attempt 1 returned an original required failure on ASan Light A job `139013044656`. Step 8 reported CTest #240 `p1773_sequential_writer_rollback.unit` timed out at 90.06 s, with 687 of 688 tests passing. This records the timeout and leaves its cause to the priority diagnosis on #1778. Main was still the original pin and #1781 was still an exact open draft at the STOP snapshot. [Original job](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/45557517904/job/139013044656) · [C priority diagnosis on #1778](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/1778#issuecomment-7154767011)

The 21,650-byte FIRST hash is `48bc8856c3e34150f0e5b11a27112587e2596b658d5b4ceb57e3412780a42962`. Original `GATE0.sha256` has 844 verified members, SHA-256 `c5322448d68a3c956ea119f3c9fca36b58badae4062eb51b4c506a34e2b1dd22`. The decoded original job log is in `p1782-observed-mode-handoff/evidence/intake/pr1781-required-red/job-log.connector.txt`, SHA-256 `d37df40caba5eb4a94bd7c0382d7cf8277c94e06274d5c134af0190ce73e74f5`. Independent F/R input exposure is zero. **STOP C for #1782.**

Local stop inventory `STOP-RAW.sha256` verifies 915 members, SHA-256 `245dbecfabc10408f96ce1c7ae221b4d6393a675172ac05af64a279bc7424cf7`.
